mandatory_work: Q4/Q5/Q6 projection tensors are distinct. Runtime already attempts Q4/Q6 mixed pair/triple and Q4 gate/up fused owners; co-scheduling cannot share weight bytes across different tensors. W1 supplied within-tensor one-decode owners and exhausted their geometry/pipeline gate.
historical_guard: The gfx1100 B4 FFN megakernel was 2.66x slower on GPU; a giant fused owner is disallowed absent a larger measured bound.
decision: Close W2 measured-blocked. Even deleting all measured target non-kernel/launch gap saves only 4.31% of target, less of full wall and far below 19.2/20.1%. Mandatory distinct-weight kernel work remains. No implementation is justified.
